info.name: UMC API
info.description:
UMC Construction Management REST API.

1. Select the **UMC Local** environment and fill in `email` / `password`.
2. Run **Auth → Login**; it stores the access token in `{{accessToken}}`, which every request uses as its Bearer token. The refresh token is kept by Postman's cookie jar for **Refresh** and **Logout**.
3. Each **Create** request stores the new id (e.g. `{{clientId}}`) for the Get / Update / Delete requests.

Responses use the `{ success, data, meta }` envelope; failures are `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details? }, meta }`.

request.description: Returns 503 when MongoDB is unreachable.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Register, login, refresh and logout are public; Me requires a Bearer token.

request.description: Self-service sign-up. Creates a new company and its first user with the OWNER role (the role cannot be chosen), then signs them in: returns 201 with `{ accessToken, tokenType, expiresIn, user }` and sets the `umc_refresh_token` httpOnly cookie. 409 when the email is already registered. Saves the access token into `{{accessToken}}`.
Returns `{ accessToken, tokenType, expiresIn, user }` and sets the `umc_refresh_token` httpOnly cookie. Saves the access token into `{{accessToken}}`.
Uses the `umc_refresh_token` cookie (sent automatically from the cookie jar). Rotates the cookie and saves the new access token.
Revokes the refresh token cookie. Returns 204.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description: Public: called by Meta, authenticated by signature instead of a session. Enabled only when WHATSAPP_PROVIDER=meta and WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET is set (404 otherwise). Configure the callback URL <API>/api/webhooks/whatsapp in the Meta App Dashboard and subscribe to the messages field.

request.description: Meta subscription handshake: answers the challenge as text/plain; 403 when the token does not match.

header.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the exact body with WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET, hex encoded

request.description: Applies message status updates (sent, delivered, read, failed) to the invoice that sent the message; statuses never move backwards. 401 when the signature is invalid. Returns { updates } with the number of status updates found.

request.description: Assignments for one worker. The path id may be an employee or a contractor employee id. 404 when the worker is not in your company.

Saves the new id into `{{workAssignmentId}}`. Site and employee must be in your company. `dailyRate` defaults to the employee's current rate. A worker can hold only one SCHEDULED or COMPLETED assignment per date (409 otherwise).

Saves the new id into `{{workAssignmentId}}`. `contractorId` is optional and derived from the contractor employee; when sent it must match. `dailyRate` defaults to the contractor employee's current rate. A worker can hold only one SCHEDULED or COMPLETED assignment per date (409 otherwise).

Schedules 1-100 workers (`employeeIds` and `contractorEmployeeIds` combined; either list may be omitted) at one site for one day, in a single transaction. `workType` defaults to each employee's role and is required when `contractorEmployeeIds` is not empty; `dailyRate` is each worker's current rate. Returns `{ succeeded: WorkAssignment[], failed: { workerType, workerId, reason, message, existingAssignmentId?, existingSiteId? }[] }`, both ordered employees first, then contractor employees. Failure reasons: DUPLICATE_IN_REQUEST, WORKER_NOT_FOUND, ALREADY_ASSIGNED (worker already holds a SCHEDULED or COMPLETED assignment that day). 201 when at least one assignment was created, 200 when all failed, 400 when the site is not in your company.

All fields optional, but at least one is required. Accepts siteId, employeeId (EMPLOYEE assignments only), contractorEmployeeId (CONTRACTOR_EMPLOYEE assignments only), date, workType, dailyRate, status (SCHEDULED | COMPLETED | CANCELLED), notes. workerType cannot change. Changing the worker re-snapshots dailyRate unless it is sent too.
Returns 204 with no body.
Every image attached to the work assignment, oldest first, with metadata and a download URL. The same list is embedded as `attachments` in the work assignment itself.

item.name: Invoices
item.description: Requires roles — view: OWNER, ADMIN, MANAGER; manage: OWNER, ADMIN, MANAGER. A worker payment has at most one invoice: a PDF payment receipt (company, invoice number, date, site, worker/contractor, work details, amount, payment mode, notes) rendered with Puppeteer and kept in file storage. Invoice numbers are INV-<year>-<sequence>, per company and per year of the invoice date. Deleting a payment also deletes its invoice and PDF. Invoices can be sent to the recipient over WhatsApp as a PDF document (send endpoint, or sendWhatsapp on create); whatsappStatus then moves NOT_SENT → QUEUED → SENT → DELIVERED → READ, or FAILED with a user-facing whatsappError.

query.description: Matches invoice number or recipient name (case-insensitive)
Inclusive end invoiceDate, YYYY-MM-DD; must not be before from

request.description: Sorted newest invoiceDate first, then most recently issued.

Issues the invoice of a payment in your company and renders its PDF; returns 201 with status GENERATED and saves the new id into `{{invoiceId}}`. Only paymentId is required. invoiceDate defaults to the payment date; workDetails defaults to the payment description. workPeriod (at most 62 days) lists the worker's SCHEDULED and COMPLETED assignments in that range (at the payment's site, if any). 409 when the payment already has an invoice (details.invoiceId); 503 when the PDF could not be rendered (the invoice is kept with status FAILED; regenerate it). Set sendWhatsapp to true to also send the PDF to the recipient phone on file over WhatsApp; a failed send does not fail the request — the invoice is returned with whatsappStatus FAILED and whatsappError.
Invoice metadata. The PDF itself is only available through View / Download PDF, which check access.
Streams the PDF with Content-Type application/pdf and Content-Disposition inline, for in-browser viewing. 409 when no PDF has been generated yet.
Same as View invoice PDF, but with Content-Disposition attachment; filename="<invoiceNumber>.pdf".

Re-renders the PDF from the payment's current amount, worker and site, keeping the invoice number; also retries FAILED invoices. The body is optional and every field in it is optional: omitted fields keep their stored value, workPeriod: null removes the period, and an empty string clears workDetails or notes. The previous PDF is replaced.

Sends the invoice PDF as a WhatsApp document (uploaded to WhatsApp as media; uses the WHATSAPP_INVOICE_TEMPLATE_NAME template when configured) and saves the message status on the invoice. The PDF is regenerated first if it is missing or FAILED. phone is optional and defaults to the recipient phone on file; it must include the country code. Returns 200 with whatsappStatus SENT. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR on phone (none on file or invalid); 409 while another send of the same invoice is in progress; 503 WHATSAPP_NOT_CONFIGURED when the server has no WhatsApp provider; 502 WHATSAPP_SEND_FAILED when WhatsApp rejected or did not answer (details.retryable). Every failure after validation is also recorded on the invoice as whatsappStatus FAILED with whatsappError. Transient provider errors are retried automatically.

Amounts rounded to two decimals.

item.name: Reports
item.description: Requires roles — view: OWNER, ADMIN, MANAGER. The site financial report sums client receipts, worker payments and expenses per site (see its request). The worker financial report is built with a MongoDB aggregation over SCHEDULED and COMPLETED work assignments (work days = assignedDays, earned = sum of snapshotted daily rates) and all payments (work payments, advances, other). outstandingAmount = earnedAmount - paidAmount; negative when paid ahead. Amounts rounded to two decimals. employeeId cannot be combined with contractorId or contractorEmployeeId (400); with both contractorId and contractorEmployeeId, the contractor employee must belong to that contractor (400). 400 when a filtered site, employee, contractor or contractor employee is not in your company.

request.description: Same roles as the dashboard (OWNER, ADMIN, MANAGER). One row per site with any matching client receipt, worker payment or expense, sorted by site name: { siteId, siteName, siteCode, clientReceipts, employeePayments, contractorPayments, materialExpenses, otherExpenses, totalExpenses, balance }. Employee payments go to own employees, contractor payments to contractor employees (every payment type counts). Other expenses are every category except MATERIAL. totalExpenses = employeePayments + contractorPayments + materialExpenses + otherExpenses; balance = clientReceipts - totalExpenses. Records not tied to a site are grouped in a last row with siteId null. Response also has `totals` (including siteCount) and echoes the applied `filters`. 400 when the site is not in your company.
